svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1061 commits across five public projects, 72 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-02 through 2026-10-24 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-24T15:52:22.845Z.
